hints.title: Middle Edge Centric Perspective
hints.text: A sequence of 4 distinct connected nodes has the form (a - u - v - b), where (u, v) is the middle edge.

hints.title: Top-3 Neighbors Precomputation
hints.text: For each node, only its top 3 highest-scoring neighbors can ever be part of the optimal sequence.

hints.title: Iterating Middle Edges
hints.text: For each directed edge (u, v), test all combinations of a in top3(u) and b in top3(v) such that a, u, v, b are all distinct.

hints.title: Edge Candidate Search Implementation

complexity.notes: For each edge (u, v), at most 3 x 3 = 9 candidate pairs are tested.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all 4-node paths by DFS takes O(V^4) or O(deg^3) which TLEs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Top-3 neighbor lists take O(V) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate centers sequence on middle edge (u, v) and restricts endpoints to top 3 neighbors.
